title: A tiger among tulsi plants
literal_meaning: A tiger in a tulsi garden.
explanation: The source imagines a cat claiming a tiger’s stature in a small setting. It mocks someone displaying modest knowledge as great authority where others cannot readily challenge it. The target is inflated self-importance, not the worth of people with less schooling.
meaning_odia: ଛୋଟ ତୁଳସୀ ବଣରେ ବିରାଡ଼ି ନିଜକୁ ବାଘ ଭାବୁଛି—ଅଭିଧାନର ବ୍ୟାଖ୍ୟାର ଛବି ଏହି। ଅଳ୍ପ ଜାଣି ମଧ୍ୟ ପ୍ରଶ୍ନ କରିବା ଲୋକ ନଥିବା ଜାଗାରେ ବଡ଼ ପଣ୍ଡିତ ସାଜିବାକୁ ଏହା ଟାହି କରେ। କମ୍ ପାଠ ପଢ଼ିଥିବା ଲୋକଙ୍କୁ ତୁଚ୍ଛ କରିବା ଏହି ପାଠର ଉଦ୍ଦେଶ୍ୟ ନୁହେଁ।
english_summary: The source imagines a cat claiming a tiger’s stature in a small setting.
odia_summary: ଛୋଟ ତୁଳସୀ ବଣରେ ବିରାଡ଼ି ନିଜକୁ ବାଘ ଭାବୁଛି—ଅଭିଧାନର ବ୍ୟାଖ୍ୟାର ଛବି ଏହି।
usage_example: A novice gives absolute technical advice to beginners, then avoids an experienced person’s questions. (Original imagined example.)
cultural_context: Historical gloss uses demeaning educational/status labels; retained meaning is criticism of inflated authority, with those labels not endorsed. Cat/tiger scene is figurative, not animal-behaviour evidence.
